coverImageAlt: A wooden teaching toolkit holds blank cards, dialogue shapes, and a glowing cyan lantern.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Creating a teaching assistant represented by a compact workshop that assembles adaptable lesson pieces around a central guiding lantern.
Scene/backdrop: An uncluttered warm paper workbench framed by a quiet slate alcove.
Subject: A wooden teaching toolkit, modular blank cards, tactile question-and-feedback shapes without glyphs, and a small cyan-and-orange guidance lantern.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; one crop-safe toolkit silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: welcoming, organized, quietly capable
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: every card and surface blank and unmarked; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
